setup.intro.welcome: Welcome! HA NOVA lets your AI assistant run your Home Assistant.
setup.intro.steps: Steps: pick your AI client, find Home Assistant, add the NOVA App, connect this computer, install the skills.
setup.intro.browser: When a browser page opens, finish there and come back here.
setup.intro.owner: You need the Home Assistant owner's account.
setup.intro.link_only: Home Assistant Link only: the NOVA App must already be installed.
setup.menu.hint: Use ↑/↓ or j/k, Enter to select, Ctrl+C to exit
setup.menu.hint_back: Use ↑/↓ or j/k, Enter to select, Esc to go back, Ctrl+C to exit
setup.menu.invalid_choice: Invalid choice. Please enter one of the listed options.
setup.clients.question: Which AI client do you use?
setup.clients.all_unavailable: install a supported AI client first
setup.clients.none_ready: No supported AI client is ready on this machine yet.
setup.clients.install_first: Install one supported client first, then rerun: ha-nova setup
setup.token.question: Choose how to set up the Relay Auth Token:
setup.token.paste: Paste existing token from another device / Home Assistant
setup.discovery.local_name_fragile: .local names can stop working (especially on Windows); its IP address is safer: type it below.
setup.discovery.find_ip: Find it in Home Assistant: Settings > System > Network.
setup.discovery.none_saved: No Home Assistant found automatically; starting from your saved address {host}
setup.discovery.none: No Home Assistant found automatically; enter its address.
setup.done.example_light: Turn off the living room light
setup.done.legacy_token: This device still connects with the shared legacy token.
setup.done.legacy_switch:
Switch to its own revocable credential: run 'ha-nova pair' and
enter a fresh code from the NOVA page ("Connect a device").
setup.done.connection_away: Away from home: Ready — Home Assistant Link
setup.done.connection_routing: Routing:        Automatic — Home Assistant Link is used only when local access is unavailable
setup.incomplete.title: Setup incomplete
setup.incomplete.ws_degraded: The NOVA App is reachable, but its Home Assistant connection is not up yet.
setup.incomplete.ws_degraded_fix: Open Home Assistant > Settings > Apps > NOVA Relay (older Home Assistant: Settings > Add-ons), verify the app settings, and restart the App.
setup.incomplete.relay_unreachable: HA NOVA saved your local setup, but the relay could not be verified yet.
setup.incomplete.relay_unreachable_fix: Open Home Assistant > Settings > Apps > NOVA Relay (older Home Assistant: Settings > Add-ons) and start the app.
setup.incomplete.skills: The Home Assistant connection is configured, but local skill installation still needs another run.
setup.incomplete.skills_fix: Re-run setup or install the HA NOVA skills again for your client.
setup.incomplete.link: Local access and skills are ready, but the selected Home Assistant Link connection is not.
setup.incomplete.link_fix: Re-run setup to resume Home Assistant Link authorization; local access remains available.
setup.incomplete.generic: HA NOVA saved your local setup, but the system is not fully ready yet.
setup.incomplete.rerun: Then run "ha-nova setup" again — it continues where you left off.
setup.resumed_pairing: Resumed the interrupted pairing — this device is connected.
setup.prompt.open_browser: Press Enter to open your browser
setup.link.unavailable_build: Home Assistant Link access is unavailable because this build or platform has Cloud setup disabled.
setup.service.credential_moved: Moved this install's device credential into protected service file storage.
setup.storage.file_backed: No OS keyring is reachable here — this device will pair with secure file-backed storage instead of a shared token.
setup.storage.warn_session_unavailable: secure storage unavailable in this Linux session; run HA NOVA from a terminal inside the Linux desktop session on this machine so local secure storage is available
setup.storage.warn_unavailable: secure storage unavailable on this Linux machine; start a Secret Service provider (for example GNOME Keyring or KWallet Secrets) before finishing setup
setup.storage.warn_not_initialized: secure storage is present but not initialized on this Linux machine; finish local secure storage setup before finishing setup
setup.storage.warn_locked: secure storage is present but locked on this Linux machine; unlock the default keyring before finishing setup
setup.storage.warn_not_ready: secure storage is present but not ready on this Linux machine; finish local secure storage setup before finishing setup
setup.host.saved_unusable: The saved address {url} could not be used. Enter a new one.
setup.token.separate_access: NOVA keeps client and Home Assistant access separate:
setup.token.separate_relay: a) This Relay token protects the connection from this computer
setup.token.separate_app: b) The Home Assistant App receives its upstream access automatically
setup.token.standalone: Standalone Container/Core relays keep HA_LLAT in the server environment; the CLI never asks for it.
setup.token.using_flag: Using the Relay Auth Token you already provided.
setup.token.generated: Here is your relay token (generated automatically):
setup.token.next_on_app_page: Next, on the NOVA App page:
setup.token.app_step_paste: 2. Paste the token into the "Relay Auth Token" field ("relay_auth_token")
setup.token.app_step_restart: 4. Restart the App so it picks up the new token
setup.token.wait_saved: Press Enter after you saved the Relay Auth Token and restarted the NOVA App
setup.token.reuse_note: If this token already works on another device, the next verification step should succeed without any new Home Assistant changes.
setup.verify.device_not_answering: Paired, but the secure device endpoint did not answer yet. The App may still be starting.
setup.verify.adding_link: Local access is ready. Now connecting Home Assistant Link for away-from-home access.
setup.error.inspect_retirement: cannot inspect interrupted device credential retirement: {error}
setup.error.finish_retirement: cannot finish the interrupted device credential retirement: {error}
setup.error.service_needs_client: service credentials require a specific client; use: ha-nova setup --service <client>
setup.error.service_move_credential: cannot move the device credential into service file storage: {error}
setup.error.profile_identity: cannot prepare the server profile identity: {error}
setup.app.running_outdated: NOVA App is running (v{version}; update to v{minimum} or newer after setup: Settings > Apps > NOVA Relay)
setup.verify.device_checking: Checking the secure connection to the NOVA App.
setup.page.title: HA NOVA Setup
setup.page.looking.title: Looking around…
setup.page.looking.lead: HA NOVA is looking for your Home Assistant. This takes a few seconds.
setup.page.found.title: We found your home.
setup.page.found.lead: HA NOVA looked around. Here's what it found. No questions so far.
setup.page.found.lead_ask: HA NOVA looked around but didn't find it on its own. Type its address below.
setup.page.found.fine_install: You sign in on your own Home Assistant page as the owner. HA NOVA then installs only its own App.
setup.page.found.fine_signin: You sign in on your own Home Assistant page as the owner.
setup.page.found.fine_access: Home Assistant will say “You're about to give {client} access”. That is this page.
setup.page.ha.several: Several found. Which one is yours?
setup.page.app.unknown: Checked once Home Assistant is found
setup.page.app.missing: Not installed in Home Assistant yet
setup.page.noclient.title: No AI app found on this computer.
setup.page.noclient.lead: HA NOVA works through an AI assistant on this computer. Install one, then check again.
setup.page.connect.title: Setting up NOVA in your Home Assistant.
setup.page.connect.lead: This takes about a minute. You can watch, or get a coffee.
setup.page.signin.waiting: Waiting for you to sign in to Home Assistant.
setup.page.problem.address: Couldn't reach Home Assistant at {address}. Check the address and try again.
setup.page.problem.not_owner: Signed in as {name}, who isn't the owner. Only the owner can connect a computer.
setup.page.problem.not_owner_unnamed: That account isn't the owner. Only the owner can connect a computer.
setup.page.problem.no_apps: This Home Assistant has no Apps. Follow the container guide.
setup.page.problem.timeout: No sign-in arrived within five minutes.
setup.page.problem.canceled: The sign-in was canceled in Home Assistant.
setup.page.problem.app_not_ready: The NOVA App isn't ready to connect computers yet. Try again in a minute.
setup.page.problem.certificate: Home Assistant's HTTPS certificate isn't trusted on this computer. Try its local http:// address or its IP address.
setup.page.problem.redirect: Home Assistant answered from a different address. Use the address Home Assistant shows in its own settings.
setup.page.problem.unreachable: Home Assistant didn't answer. Check that it's running, then try again.
setup.page.problem.generic: The sign-in with Home Assistant didn't finish.
setup.page.terminal.title: Continue in the terminal.
setup.page.terminal.lead: Setup needs an answer in the terminal window. This page shows when setup is done.
setup.page.done.title: This computer is connected.
setup.page.done.lead: HA NOVA is ready in {clients}. Your first look at your home is in the terminal.
setup.page.incomplete.title: Setup isn't finished yet.
setup.page.incomplete.lead: The terminal says what's left. Run setup again to continue where you left off.
setup.page.finished.title: Setup finished in the terminal.
setup.page.failed.title: Setup stopped.
setup.page.stopped.title: Setup was stopped in the terminal.
setup.page.stopped.lead: Start setup again in the terminal whenever you're ready.
setup.page.elsewhere.title: This setup page is already open in another tab.
setup.page.elsewhere.lead: Use that tab, or start setup again in the terminal.
setup.page.found.fine_terminal: This NOVA App can't be set up from this page. The terminal shows the next step.
setup.page.idle.title: Setup stopped because nothing happened for a while.
setup.page.idle.lead: Start setup again in the terminal whenever you're ready.
setup.page.lost.title: This page lost touch with setup.
setup.page.lost.lead: The terminal shows how setup ended.
setup.page.terminal.page: Closed the setup page? Open {url} in the same browser.
setup.page.problem.pairing: This computer couldn't connect through Home Assistant. Try again, or use a six-digit code.
setup.page.found.lead_several: HA NOVA found more than one. Pick yours, or type its address.
setup.page.terminal.home: Your home at a glance is on the setup page now. Click Done there, or press Ctrl+C here, to close setup.
setup.page.closed.title: Setup is finished.
setup.page.closed.lead: Nothing in your home changed unless you saved it. You can close this tab.
setup.page.control.title: You stay in control.
setup.page.control.lead: Unlocks and deletes always wait for you. Your AI assistant never sees a code.
setup.page.control.window_value: A small window asks before anything risky runs.
setup.page.control.window_off: No confirmation window can open on this computer. A linked phone asks instead.
setup.page.control.phone_value: “{phone}” asks too. The first answer counts.
setup.page.control.phone_pick: Pick your phone. It gets one notification.
setup.page.control.phone_waiting: Tap “Link” on {phone}. Expand the notification to see it.
setup.page.control.phone_none: No phone with the Home Assistant app found.
setup.page.control.phone_unavailable: Your phone can be linked later. Ask your AI assistant to link it.
setup.page.control.phone_problem: Linking {phone} didn't work. Nothing was linked; try again.
setup.page.control.phone_timeout: “Link” wasn't tapped on {phone} in time. Nothing was linked; try again.
setup.page.control.phone_declined: It was cancelled on {phone}. Nothing was linked.
setup.page.control.phone_rejected: The tap on {phone} came from another Home Assistant account. Link a phone signed in with your own.
setup.page.control.phone_unreachable: HA NOVA couldn't reach {phone}. Check that its Home Assistant app is signed in, then try again.
setup.page.control.rule_key: Let Claude Code show the window
setup.page.control.rule_value: Adds one rule to Claude Code so its auto mode doesn't block the confirmation window.
setup.page.control.rule_on: Claude Code already has this rule.
setup.page.control.link_key: Use HA NOVA away from home
setup.page.control.link_value: Adds Home Assistant Link as a fallback when this computer can't reach Home Assistant at home.
setup.page.control.link_run: Sign in to Home Assistant Link in the tab that opened.
setup.page.control.fine: Turning on your phone sends one notification to that phone. Tap “Link” there.
setup.page.home.title: Here's your home, at a glance.
setup.page.home.failed: HA NOVA couldn't read your home just now. Your assistant can show it any time.
setup.page.home.note_rule: Claude Code got its rule: it can show the confirmation window.
setup.page.home.note_rule_failed: Claude Code's settings weren't changed. The terminal says how to add the rule yourself.
setup.page.home.note_link: Home Assistant Link is ready as a fallback away from home.

setup.page.home.battery_low_more.one: It will stop reporting in a few weeks.
setup.page.home.battery_low_more.other: {count} batteries are low. This one is the lowest.

setup.page.home.no_room_more: Rooms make “turn off the kitchen” work.

setup.page.home.device_offline.one: {name} has been offline for over a day
setup.page.home.device_offline.other: {count} devices have been offline for over a day, among them {name}

setup.page.home.automation_never_ran.other: {count} automations have never run, among them “{name}”

setup.page.home.automation_never_ran_mor: Ask your assistant what it waits for.
setup.page.home.rooms_note: Nothing is saved until you choose “Save rooms”.
setup.page.home.rooms_saved: Saved ✓ These devices are in their rooms now.
setup.page.home.undo_lead: These go back to their previous rooms:
setup.page.home.undo_note: Nothing changes until you choose “Put them back”.
setup.page.home.evicted: To make room, the undo for these older changes is gone: {names}.
setup.page.home.t_door_light_lock: Light on when {trigger} is unlocked after dark
setup.page.home.t_door_light_door: Light on when {trigger} opens after dark
setup.page.home.t_lights_off: Lights off when everyone has left
setup.page.home.t_reminder: A reminder when a battery runs low
setup.page.home.when_away: nobody has been home for 10 minutes
setup.page.home.template_note: Nothing is saved until you choose “{button}”.
setup.page.home.drift: Something changed in Home Assistant since the preview. This is the new one.
setup.page.home.problem.generic: That didn't work, and nothing was saved.
setup.page.home.problem.unknown: HA NOVA can't tell whether it was saved. Ask your assistant to check.
setup.page.home.problem.drift: Something changed in Home Assistant since the preview, so nothing was saved.
setup.page.home.problem.unverified: Saved, but the check afterwards didn't match. Ask your assistant to look.
setup.page.home.problem.no_rooms: HA NOVA has no confident room suggestion right now. Nothing was saved.
setup.page.home.problem.not_offered: This suggestion doesn't fit your home right now. Nothing was saved.
setup.page.home.problem.rooms_not_saved: Home Assistant refused one of the changes, so nothing was saved.
setup.page.home.problem.rooms_partial: A problem stopped it, and some devices changed room. Undo puts them back.
setup.page.home.problem.nothing_to_undo: They are already back in their previous rooms.
setup.page.home.problem.expired: This preview is no longer valid. Nothing was saved; preview it again.
setup.page.home.prompt_kitchen: Turn off everything in the kitchen
setup.page.home.copied_claude: Copied. Paste it into Claude Code.
setup.page.home.copied: Copied. Paste it into your AI assistant.
setup.page.home.opened: Claude Code is opening in a new terminal window.
setup.page.home.manual: Open a terminal and type claude to start Claude Code.
setup.page.home.fine: Tap a phrase to copy it. Nothing in your home changed unless you saved it.
